title: Welfare law for disabled persons can't be misused to settle spats between residents of apartment: Karnataka HC
description: The Karnataka High Court on Friday warned against invoking the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act to settle scores in ordinary disputes that do not involve any discrimination against persons with disabilities [Y Venkateshwara Prasad & others v.
